about: Swapped monster overlay art over a captive with no skin tone (skin -1): the game's generic touch overlays hold 3 rows per cell, so gnx_mon_frame must skip to her cell's row x 3 for the swapped art too, as touch_skin_rows checks for game sprites (fixture WALL 3: row 6, 5 frames per row: frame 32 -> 92). A mod strip put in place of a listed overlay is flagged (gnx_skin3_marks); a vanilla overlay swapped in is listed already; art with no flag stays as it is; atlas art (a struct) carries its own flag. An atlas entry swapped in for a listed overlay by a real class compile gets the flag too (harness_art_skin_atlas).
